sentences.text: Gobisaurus domoculus was a herbivorous basal ankylosaurid dinosaur, meaning it was an early member of the armored dinosaur group. This genus is monotypic, containing only this single species.

A Sino-Soviet Expedition discovered the skeleton of Gobisaurus in the Gobi Desert of Inner Mongolia between 1959 and 1960. Matthew K. Vickaryous, Anthony P. Russell, Philip John Currie, and Zhao Xijin named and described Gobisaurus domoculus in 2001. The generic name Gobisaurus means "Gobi (Desert) lizard," referring to where the fossils were found.
The fossil record for Gobisaurus spans from the Aptian to the Albian stages, between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago.
In 2014, Victoria Arbour concluded that Zhongyuansaurus might be a junior synonym of Gobisaurus based on the extensive postcranial remains found in its type specimen.
